cards.art: Scissors cutting dotted lines on printed card
cards.lore: This isn't a PDF. It's raw material. Print it. Cut along the dotted lines. If you don't cut it, it doesn't work.
cards.name: DESTROY THIS DECK

cards.art: Duck grabbing a card with gleam in eye
cards.lore: Draw a card. That's you now. You aren't playing a game; you're arguing a perspective.
cards.name: PICK YOUR ACTOR

cards.art: Three cards laid out like a map
cards.lore: Lay out 3 cards. Connect them. If the connection makes sense, you're boring. If it's Kayfabizarro, you're winning.
cards.name: BUILD THE STAGE

cards.art: Die rolling through a vortex
cards.lore: Roll the die. [1] is static. [6] is a riot. Push the story until the die breaks.
cards.name: THE QUEST DIE

cards.art: Bear playing bone flute, spirit rising
cards.lore: The first instrument wasn't for art. It was a remote control for the human heart.
cards.name: THE BONE FLUTE

cards.art: Gorilla drumming with evolution chain behind
cards.lore: Before the state, there was rhythm. When hearts beat together, individual boundaries dissolve.
cards.name: THE WAR DRUM

cards.art: Owl-shaman with rattle before fire
cards.lore: The musician didn't entertain. They managed the tribe's reality.
cards.name: THE SHAMAN

cards.art: Bat emitting sonar waves over a landscape
cards.lore: Sound defines the space. If you control the echo, you define the boundaries of the world.
cards.name: THE ECHO

cards.art: Row of identical monks chanting in unison
cards.lore: One voice. One truth. No harmony allowed, because harmony implies there is more than one perspective.
cards.name: GREGORIAN CHANT

cards.art: Goat playing distorted guitar, interval notation
cards.lore: The Devil in Music. The interval that refuses to resolve, banned for centuries because tension is dangerous.
cards.name: THE TRITONUS (DIABOLUS)

cards.art: Octopus-machine pipe organ in cathedral
cards.lore: The most expensive machine in the pre-industrial world. It speaks with the voice of God and the budget of the State.
cards.name: THE PIPE ORGAN

cards.art: Visionary dove over psychedelic illumination
cards.lore: Avant-garde ecstasy framed as divine dictation. The only way to break the rules was to claim God wrote them.
cards.name: HILDEGARD'S VISION

cards.art: Spider weaving music staff as web
cards.lore: A musical argument where voices invert and combine. It's not a song; it's dialectical logic.
cards.name: THE FUGUE

cards.art: Lion composing with broken ears, music floating inward
cards.lore: Proof that music lives in mental architecture, not sound. He built the structure after the world went quiet.
cards.name: THE DEAF COMPOSER

cards.art: Dog with bell Pavlov-style, musical notes as cue
cards.lore: A musical tag for a character. It tells the audience exactly how to feel before the character even speaks.
cards.name: THE LEITMOTIF

cards.art: Peacock conducting hidden orchestra in darkened opera house
cards.lore: Dim the lights. Hide the orchestra. The audience doesn't observe; they are absorbed.
cards.name: BAYREUTH (TOTAL ART)

cards.art: Black cat at midnight crossroads with shadow figure
cards.lore: Transcendent ability costs something you can't get back. The deal is real, even if the Devil is a metaphor.
cards.name: THE CROSSROADS

cards.art: Candle-moth over memorial flame
cards.lore: The pattern is the point. Extreme creative gifts often consume the vessel that carries them.
cards.name: THE 27 CLUB

cards.art: Snake forming infinity loop from music notation
cards.lore: Statement, repeat, response. It's not laziness; it's the insistence that the suffering is real.
cards.name: THE 12-BAR LOOP

cards.art: Wolf howling at moon, cracked note symbol
cards.lore: The note that shouldn't work but does. It hurts because it's true.
cards.name: THE BLUE NOTE

cards.art: Turtle trumpeter facing brick wall
cards.lore: He didn't play for them. He played for the music. If they didn't get it, that was their problem.
cards.name: THE TURNED BACK

cards.art: Crane playing saxophone toward celestial light
cards.lore: Not a song, but a spiritual practice using the Saxophone as a prayer wheel.
cards.name: LOVE SUPREME

cards.art: Cat juggling fire torches on a wire
cards.lore: The moment it becomes comfortable, it's wrong. You have to be ahead of your own understanding.
cards.name: THE IMPROVISER

cards.art: Raccoons jamming in smoky basement
cards.lore: Discovery happens in the gaps. No rehearsal, just sketches and trust.
cards.name: THE SESSION

cards.art: Weasel in suit handing cash to broadcasting tower
cards.lore: Hits are manufactured, not discovered. It's illegal to bribe a DJ, but it's legal to buy a playlist.
cards.name: PAYOLA

cards.art: Golden retriever in spotlight on factory assembly line
cards.lore: Find a vessel that can carry the music without carrying the threat. Safe, pretty, and profitable.
cards.name: THE TEEN IDOL

cards.art: Poodle polishing a spiked collar smooth
cards.lore: Sand down the edges. Repackage the raw emotion for a broader market. Keep the money.
cards.name: THE COVER VERSION

cards.art: Parrot repeating into microphone with price tag
cards.lore: A self-fulfilling prediction. Play it until they like it. Familiarity breeds purchase.
cards.name: TOP 40

cards.art: Rabbit drumming loop spinning into fractal genre explosion
cards.lore: Six seconds of drums from 1969 that built entire genres. The drummer died broke.
cards.name: THE AMEN BREAK

cards.art: Magpie building nest from stolen record fragments
cards.lore: The Bronx had no budget, so they used the past as a brickyard. Theft? No. Collage.
cards.name: THE SAMPLER

cards.art: Mole surfacing with golden record
cards.lore: Buried knowledge. Finding the break that everyone else walked past.
cards.name: THE CRATE DIGGER

cards.art: Vulture with DOMAIN stamp blocking public domain
cards.lore: The law didn't evolve to protect artists. It evolved to protect the owners of the catalog.
cards.name: COPYRIGHT BOT

cards.art: Spider in server room weaving attention web
cards.lore: It doesn't care what you like. It cares what you won't skip. Optimization leads to sameness.
cards.name: THE ALGORITHM

cards.art: Grasshopper with megaphone flattening audio waveform
cards.lore: Eliminate dynamic range. If everything is loud, nothing is urgent.
cards.name: LOUDNESS WAR

cards.art: Hamster on wheel labeled Chill/Focus/Party
cards.lore: A mood buffer. Context is removed. The artist is irrelevant. Just keep the vibe steady.
cards.name: THE PLAYLIST

cards.art: Worm entering ear with stopwatch and comfort pillow
cards.lore: The metric is time spent. The goal is to keep you here, mildly satisfied, forever.
cards.name: RETENTION RATE

cards.art: Mouse soldier marching beside metronome
cards.lore: Standardized in 1939. Some say it creates subtle psychological dissonance. A frequency for workers, not dreamers.
cards.name: 440 Hz (STANDARD)

cards.art: Capybara meditating with tuning fork and cosmos
cards.lore: The mathematical vibration of the universe. Or maybe just a placebo. But it feels slower.
cards.name: 432 Hz (NATURAL)

cards.art: Hawk guitarist in canyon with military shadow
cards.lore: Why did so many 60s rock stars have fathers in military intelligence? Just a coincidence. Surely.
cards.name: LAUREL CANYON

cards.art: Bat hanging upside-down listening to backwards record
cards.lore: The subconscious hears what the ear misses. Or maybe it's just noise. Do it.
cards.name: BACKMASKING

cards.art: Bear composing in hospital bed surrounded by IV tubes and sheet music
cards.lore: Producing masterpieces while dying. The industry ignored him; the culture canonized him.
cards.name: THE HOSPITAL BED

cards.art: Lion at mic transforming sheet music into proclamation
cards.lore: She didn't change the notes. She changed the subject position. Suddenly, the song was a demand.
cards.name: THE RESPECT

cards.art: Chameleon mid-transformation between personas with lightning bolt
cards.lore: The mask isn't hiding the self. The mask *is* the character before they get bored.
cards.name: THE CHAMELEON

cards.art: Sloth conducting empty stage, audience as instrument
cards.lore: 4'33". The music is the coughing of the audience. The frame determines the art.
cards.name: THE SILENCE

cards.art: Bird weaving nest with thread that frays at either end
cards.lore: [1]: Silence. (Too stable.) [6]: Riot. (Too chaotic.)
cards.name: QUEST - The Perfect Song

cards.art: Handshake over contract that splits in two directions
cards.lore: [1]: Sold Out. (Soul lost.) [6]: Bankrupt. (Money lost.)
cards.name: QUEST - The Record Deal

cards.art: Pig musicians in mud versus burning stage
cards.lore: [1]: Rained Out. (Depression.) [6]: Woodstock '99. (Fire.)
cards.name: QUEST - The Festival

cards.art: Worm with headphones in apple, spreading sound waves
cards.lore: [1]: Elevator Music. (Ignored.) [6]: Mass Hysteria. (Viral infection.)
cards.name: QUEST - The Earworm
